experiment.name: ecg-hybrid-net-exp12-optimization
experiment.combined_order: quantize original graph, then serialize optimized INT8 graph

experiments.name: baseline
experiments.description: Original FP32 graph with ORT graph optimization disabled

experiments.name: compiler_only
experiments.description: Serialized ORT-optimized FP32 graph with runtime optimization disabled

experiments.name: quantization_only
experiments.description: INT8 graphs quantized from the original FP32 graph

experiments.name: compiler_plus_quantization
experiments.description: INT8 graphs quantized from the original graph, then serialized with ORT_ENABLE_EXTENDED

experiments.name: default_runtime_optimization
experiments.description: FP32 and INT8 graphs loaded at ORT's default graph optimization level (ORT_ENABLE_ALL)

static_int8_interaction.definition: The interaction survives when the sign of the batch-1 median latency gap between static INT8 and compiled static INT8 is the same with runtime optimization disabled and with ORT's default level, ORT_ENABLE_ALL.
